metadata.method: For each year, use that year's deterministic point-in-time CSI 300/CSI 500 cohort and only decisions inside the year.
limitations: Daily-only morphology is not a complete multi-level Chan trading strategy.
A marker is the open-source author's implementation and parameterization, not a canonical truth.
Point-in-time CSI 300/500 sampling reduces but does not eliminate selection bias.
Daily OHLCV cannot establish intraday path, queue position, or limit-board executability.
